title: UN warns Ebola may not have peaked in DR Congo, despite falling cases
summary_full: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo shows early signs of slowing.  Daily infections have decreased from approximately 120 to about 80 cases.  However, transmission continues to rise in some areas, officials caution.  Mobile data tracks population movements to predict future virus spread.  Kisangani has emerged as a key area of concern due to its transport hub status.
